objective:
THIS IS F6.4: make ClipFactory something Mario can actually RUN and EDIT. His words: 'que sean proyectos funcionales, quiero poder probar metiendo ediciones'.

STATE VERIFIED 2026-09-25: the 6 stages are implemented and the vertical acceptance is 8/8, but there is no single command that runs the pipeline end to end — you must chain 5 scripts by hand with the right paths — and scripts/match_candidates.py does not even start (ModuleNotFoundError: rapidfuzz). There is also no way to adjust a clip and re-render just that clip: moving one clip's start by two seconds means hand-editing clip_plan.json and re-cutting everything.

WHAT TO BUILD
1. scripts/pipeline.py --guion G --transcript T --video V --output DIR [--edits E]: one invocation, stages 1 through 6, resumable.
2. Do not die without rapidfuzz: declare it in scripts/requirements.txt AND degrade to a stdlib matcher (difflib) when the import fails. Running the pipeline in an environment without rapidfuzz must NOT raise ModuleNotFoundError.
3. IDEMPOTENT: re-running with the same input does not redo finished work and does not corrupt output.
4. EDITS: an edits.json where Mario adjusts start/end/title per clip id. After re-running, the edited clip reflects the new window and the clips he did NOT touch stay BYTE-IDENTICAL (do not re-encode what was not edited). An invalid edit (end <= start, unknown id) is rejected with a clear message and a non-zero exit, leaving no corrupt video behind.
5. manifest.json listing, per clip: id, path, start, end, state — so the human review stage is not guesswork.

HARD RULE from CLAUDE.md: everything ClipFactory writes lives inside this repository. The gate runs the pipeline with a fake HOME and fails if anything is written there.

The gate builds 6-second synthetic videos with ffmpeg lavfi: NO downloads, NO GPU, NO WhisperX, NO LLM. The existing vertical acceptance must stay at 8/8 or better.

SIZE OF ONE ATTEMPT: one capability from the SPINE, written to disk with its test, in one pass. An attempt that changes no file is NO_AUTHORIZED_WORK.
SPINE: S1 scripts/pipeline.py end-to-end + manifest.json -> S2 rapidfuzz optional (stdlib fallback) -> S3 idempotence/resume -> S4 edits.json with selective re-render and validation -> S5 tests/test_pipeline_e2e.py.

Acceptance: pinned acceptance/evaluate_f6_4_e2e.py returns 1 (10 checks). Today RED at 2/10.
